design.status: Exploratory additional specification, fixed after previous interview-activity results and before these fits.
design.source: Original saved interview panel and original financial data; original labels unchanged.
design.paper_basis: Gutiérrez, Lourie, Nekrasov and Shevlin (2020), Table 3 and methods on manuscript pages 9–10: changes scaled by assets; two negative quantile groups, a zero group, two positive groups; ranks 0, .25, .5, .75, 1.
design.main_predictor: Annual change in retained interview-review count divided by current assets, then assigned sign-based five-category rank. Negative and positive changes are split at their pooled median among eligible predictor observations; ties share a rank.
design.timing_difference: Annual review counts for year t versus t-1 replace active-posting counts for the first three months of t+1 versus t. This is an adaptation, not a replication or an observed-posting test.
design.ghost_measure: Previous-year raw ghost share is main, avoiding current shared reviews and the full-history smoothing prior. Current saved smoothed share is separately reported.
outcomes: (operating income after depreciation[t+1]-operating income after depreciation[t])/assets[t]
design.main_sample: Original unique USD firm-years with December year end, interior consecutive interview years, at least five reviews in both activity years, and consecutive annual financial records.
design.controls: Core: asset-scaled current changes in earnings, sales, SG&A, employment and capex plus book-to-market. Full adds R&D and advertising changes with no zero imputation.
specifications: Core controls, industry and year effects
Full benchmark controls, industry and year effects
Core controls, firm and year effects
Rebuilt annual review counts and previous-year raw ghost share
design.inference: Same observations for baseline and augmented fit within each outcome/specification. Firm-clustered errors, two-sided 95% intervals, Holm adjustment across four outcomes per specification and coefficient family.
design.reporting: All 48 fits reported. No selection based on significance. The earlier log-change adaptation and all other checks remain unchanged.
design.limits: Capped interview-review counts are not advertisement counts or actual interview volume. No claim of independent classifier accuracy, causal ghost effects, or exact Lourie replication.

public_data_access.observed_public_material: Online Appendix PDF with robustness tables and data-access instructions; no downloadable company posting-history file located.
public_data_access.appendix_instruction: Researchers are directed to Eagle Alpha for access; the appendix states that provider permission is required for sharing.

finding: Ranked interview counts do not reproduce a consistent positive growth signal; ghost interactions are inconclusive after correction. Exact posting-based test remains unestimated.
